# Validation Set Points

## Meter List/Location

The Set Points calculator requires the Validation Set Points module. Without it, you can manually enter validation parameters on the Meter Editor Validation tab for each meter.

FLOWCAL uses built-in validation set points to identify data anomalies. These set points are based on limits imposed by various calculation standards. They can also be added to meters and quality sources to flag data that is outside of normal operating boundaries.

Set points can be calculated for multiple meters at a time using the Validation Set Points calculator for Lists, Locations, and Close Groups, based on each meter’s historical data. Validation set points are determined based on data in a specified date range and the percentage of data to be flagged. To ensure that valid set points are calculated, this should only be used once data has been reviewed and verified.

Validation set points are logged to the Validation History. You can view the set point history on the [Validations tab](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Validations%20Tab.md) of the Meter Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Validation Set Points screen:

Go to **Review** \> **Set Points** \> **Meter List/Location**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 444;" />

Only data points applicable to the given meter type are displayed and calculated.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Validation Set Points Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Validation Set Points screen:

- **System and Object Selector** - Select whether to analyze data for a list, location, or close group.

- **Analyze From/To** - Specify a date range of data to analyze.

- **Percentage of data to be flagged** - This field establishes where the set points will be calculated relative to the data used. The percentage of data to be flagged is defaulted to 0.001%, which means that based on historical data, 0.001% of the user's data should be flagged with an exception in the future.

  The closer this value is to zero, the closer the set points will be to the minimum and maximum data values for each parameter. When setting these set points for the first time, it is recommended that you use .001%, so that you are not overwhelmed with exceptions.

- **Do Not Scale by Flow Time** - If this option is checked, data will not be scaled based on the flow time.

  <div class="example">

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Do Not Scale">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

  If the volume was 15 for an hour, but the flow time was only 30 minutes, then validation set point calculations will still use 15 for the volume.

  </div>

  If this option is not checked, then the volume will be scaled to one hour of flow time. Using the same example, the validation set point calculations will use 30 for the volume instead of 15.

  Scaling only applies to accumulated fields such as volume, energy, and pulse count; scaling cannot be applied to averaged fields such as pressure or differential pressure.

- **Override Pre-Existing Values** - If this option is checked, the value calculated for the set point will be used in place of previously calculated values. If the option is not checked, values that were previously calculated or manually entered will not be overwritten.

- **Run on Imports and Edits** - Check this option to activate the set points.

- **Run Min/Run Max** - For each parameter, select whether to calculate the minimum or maximum values.

- **Clear All** - Uncheck all parameters on the selected tab.

- **Check All** - Check all parameters on the selected tab.

- **Run** - Calculate and save the set points for every meter in the list, location, or close group. Go to the Validations tab in the Meter Editor to view the calculated set points.

</div>
